'''Aira cupaniana''' (silver hairgrass) is a species of annual herb in the family [[Poaceae]]. They have a self-supporting growth form and simple, broad leaves. Individuals can grow to 13 cm.<ref>{{Cite web|title=''Aira cupaniana'' Guss. - Encyclopedia of Life|url=https://eol.org/pages/5816054|access-date=2022-02-04|website=eol.org}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|last=Mifsud|first=Stephen|date=2002-08-23|title=''Aira cupaniana'' (Southern Hairgrass) : MaltaWildPlants.com - the online Flora of the Maltese Islands.|url=https://www.maltawildplants.com/POAC/Aira_cupaniana.php|access-date=2022-02-07|website=www.maltawildplants.com|language=en-us}}</ref> The species is native to southern Europe, North Africa and the [[Canary Islands]]. It is an introduced species in Australia.<ref name=POWO/>
